messages.subject: Running rmr2 and Hadoop natively on Mac OS X
parts:
I know some forum users are using Macs. I do too. Until now I have been using a VM to run Hadoop (either a Cloudera one or more recently the Hortonworks Sandbox release) and then installed RStudio in the VM. This works fine.

I know you can install both Hadoop and R Studio on the Mac itself and I was going to see if the combo would work natively on OS X -- probably the Mountain Lion release.

Anyone done this? Any work-arounds needed? Or should I not bother trying?
